caption: The drawing is primarily done in shades of brown, gray, and beige on a rectangular, cloth-like background with a red border running along the edges. It features detailed portraits of seven male figures, each inside an oval frame, arranged in a loose semicircle around the central, larger portrait of a man in military uniform. Above and around the central figure, each portrait is labeled with a name, and some with dates or presidential titles. In addition to the portraits, there is an illustration of an eagle clutching arrows and olive branches, positioned to the bottom left of the central figure, alongside a depiction of an American flag. On the lower right, there is a detailed drawing of a multi-masted sailing ship. The overall background consists of wavy, cloud-like patterns. There is visible, handwritten-style text incorporated into several parts of the drawing. A faint artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner outside the main illustration.
title: Printed Cotton - Historical
